hypothesised_pattern: The base model under-captures an even, U-shaped dependence on x4: it underpredicts when |x4| is large (either sign) and overpredicts when x4 is near zero.
rationale: All five positive residuals (+0.27 to +0.28) have |x4| between 1.06 and 1.83, including both positive and negative values (+1.621, -1.831), while all five negative residuals (about -0.27) have |x4| at most 0.33. The fact that the sign of x4 does not matter rules out a missing linear term and points to a squared term in x4.
